content.comment_body: I have a [product_name] operator panel and a [product_name] device, each with different firmware versions. I'm experiencing issues where command execution and block editing from the screen behave inconsistently. Some blocks can be edited, others cannot, even though the editable settings have been confirmed as installed. How can I align both devices to use the same firmware to resolve these problems?

Hello [user_name], The official language of this forum is English. Please write your posts in English, as not everyone here understands other languages. I didn't fully understand your issue. Could you describe your problem in more detail? If possible, please include a screenshot.

analysis.insight_summary: A user reported inconsistencies with command execution and block editing due to firmware differences between a [product_name] display and a [product_name] device. Some editing functions are available for certain blocks but not others, despite correct editable settings being installed.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks uniform functionality for command execution and block editing on both the [product_name] device and display, regardless of firmware version differences.
